verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own rule-driven automation on incident events. Escalation policies are 'a custom set of rules for incident alerting', escalation can be conditioned on time, team availability and incident origin, monitors automatically create incidents and alert on-call, and new incidents can trigger posting a todo list and routing to a responder. The documented actions are confined to alerting, escalation and routing, with no evidence of a general-purpose event-to-action rule engine. missing for 10: arbitrary custom actions beyond alerting and routing, documented rule-builder depth (conditions, action types, chaining), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: An escalation policy is a custom set of rules for incident alerting, ideal for creating advanced incident alerting processes.
